newsitem.title: CHINA: China licenses foreign asset appraising firms.
newsitem.headline: China licenses foreign asset appraising firms.

text.p: China has ordered foreign firms specialising in asset appraisal to obtain a licence before they can operate in the country, the official Legal Daily said on Friday.
Foreign firms wanting to tap the property assessing market must apply for temporary business licences from the State Administration of State Property, the newspaper said.
Foreign firms must comply with China's laws and regulations and submit to the supervision and management of the China Association of Property Assessment, it said, without giving further details.
The State Administration of State Property has set the scope of business for foreign appraising agents, it said.
They are allowed to assess assets of Chinese firms that plan to offer or to list shares in the country where the foreign apraising firm is based, it said.
They are allowed on assess assets of foreign-funded firms in China and can operate indepedently or cooperate with Chinese partners.
The rules also apply to asset appraising firms from Hong Kong, Taiwan and Macau, the newspaper said.
